prompt:
Fix snippets/membership-renewal-2.liquid so it renders a member's renewal history with correct term numbers. Input (top-level variable, always supplied): - `renewals`: array, possibly empty, never null. Each element is an object with: - `plan`: string, never null; may contain <, >, & or " characters. - `status`: string, always exactly "paid" or "lapsed". Output: - If `renewals` is empty, output nothing at all (empty string). - Otherwise output `
    `, then one `
  • ` per renewal in array order, then `
`. - Paid renewal: `
  • Term N: PLAN
    • `. N is a running counter of paid renewals only. It starts at 1 for the first paid renewal and goes up by 1 for each later paid renewal. Lapsed renewals do not advance the counter. - Lapsed renewal: `
  • Lapsed: PLAN
    • `. - PLAN is the plan string HTML-escaped with the `escape` filter. Do not strip it. - Emit no whitespace or newlines between or around tags. The whole output is a single line, for example `
    • Term 1: Gold
    • Lapsed: Silver
    • Term 2: Gold
    `. Currently the snippet numbers terms by loop position and does not escape plan names. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/membership-renewal-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
